=== 14. DNSMASQ CONFIG (Hotspot) ===
# Open5GS + srsRAN Project Hotspot DHCP Configuration
# Interface binding
interface=wlp4s0

# DHCP range for srsRAN gNB devices
dhcp-range=192.168.50.150,192.168.50.200,255.255.255.0,24h

# DNS servers
dhcp-option=option:dns-server,8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4

# Gateway (points to this machine where 5G Core runs)
dhcp-option=option:router,192.168.50.1

# Domain name
dhcp-option=option:domain-name,5gcore.local

# Lease file location
dhcp-leasefile=/var/lib/NetworkManager/dnsmasq-wlp4s0.leases

# Log DHCP transactions for debugging
log-dhcp

# Network isolation settings
bind-interfaces
except-interface=docker0
except-interface=br-*
